description: Sustained event-loop saturation on one process, from nodejs.eventloop.utilization over moltnet-metrics (0 = idle, 1 = always busy). Baseline is below 0.15. A 5-minute average at or above 0.7 means the process spends most of its time in synchronous work and queues I/O behind it. Group shows service.name and service.instance.id: compare with request volume and CPU-heavy spans on that instance.
mplQuery:
`moltnet-metrics`:`nodejs.eventloop.utilization`
| align to 5m using avg
| group by `service.name`, `service.instance.id` using max
name: MoltNet event loop saturation by instance
